title: Grilled Norwegian Salmon with Smoky Cheese Crust
description: A flavorful and healthy salmon dish, topped with a smoky cheese crust, perfect for a gluten-free dinner.
instructions: Season salmon with salt and pepper.
In a small bowl, mix together smoked cheddar cheese and gluten-free breadcrumbs.
Brush salmon with olive oil and place on grill.
Cook salmon for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
While salmon is cooking, mix together lemon juice and minced garlic.
Brush lemon juice mixture on salmon during last minute of cooking.
Top cooked salmon with cheese crust and return to grill for 1 minute.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
